title: Internal Rectangle
content: **List of Contents** Internal Rectangle Create **Internal RectangleYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FhUqT8iG0I4 ** \- Create a rectangle within a Pattern. \- Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Internal Rectangle** \- 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_2D_Shape_Inner_Square.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001215267/Toolbar_2D_Shape_Inner_Square.png)**Internal Rectangle** **Create** * **Create**** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CaCo-KlnK7o** \- Click and drag within a Pattern to create a rectangle in the 2D window. \- To create a square, hold down the Shift key from the keyboard while click and drag. * **Create with Specific ValuesYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rTEeKoKjXM** \- Click within a Pattern to create an Internal Rectangle with specific values. \- The Create Rectangle window appears. * Size Set width and height of the Internal Rectangle. * Replicate Interval : Set the distance between each replicated rectangles. Angle : Set the angle between each replicated rectangles. Number of Shapes : Set the number of rectangles to be replicated. * Position Outline : Configure the rectangle’s location by setting the its outline’s offset from the Pattern outlines’ left, right, top, and bottom. Center : Configure the rectangle’s location by setting the its center’s offset from the Pattern outlines’ left, right, top, and bottom. Go back to the List of Contents

title: How long will it take me to learn CLO?
content: **Question** How long will it take me to learn CLO? **Answer** The learning pace for CLO software differs for each individual and depends on the hours of practice and the complexity of your project. Therefore, it is hard to estimate the learning period, but everyone can reach a professional level after a certain practice. Some CLO users get it quickly through online tutorials on various channels and communicating with other CLO users via [CLO community forum](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/community/topics). If you could build your network, you may be able to acquire more extensive knowledge than others. For more information, please refer to the article about the [Available Training Resources](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115013367088).
content_description: This web page provides insights into the varying learning timelines for CLO software, highlighting the importance of practice, community engagement, and available resources for achieving proficiency.

title: Substance
content: **Set the file format as Substance at the right menu of Material, you can use SBSAR file of Substance which is the main application of physical based rendering.** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3I2jfsYkuHE #### 1. Click a fabric in ![Fabric Tab.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38101422930457) **Fabric** tab in [Object Browser](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000374247-%EB%AC%BC%EC%B2%B4%EC%B0%BD-Object-Browser-). 2. Change the material type to Substance in Property Editor. 3. Set the Substance properties in Property Editor. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Substance File** | Import SBSAR file by clicking 'Explore' or, download SBSAR file by clicking 'Go to Substance Source'. **Preset** | Choose the preset of SBSAR. **Resolution** | Adjust the image resolution of SBSAR. **[Displacement Map](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025439933-Displacement-Map-ver5-1-0-)/ Reflection/ Technical/ Transformation** | Displacement Map Properties/ Reflection Intensity/ Technical Properties/ Adjust the size, angle, and position of the map. **Custom Properties** | Edit the properties of SBSAR. ****📝******Note:** Custom Properties are different depending on the property of the file. title: Displacement Map (ver5.1.0)
content: ### ** Objective ** Express thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. Applied result can be only checked in the [Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003861567-V-Ray-%EB%A0%8C%EB%8D%94) window. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HDf5DIY-uHs ### **Location** Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ▶ Fabric (Select from the Fabric List) ▶ Property Editor ▶ Material ▶**Displacement Map** ### **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated path below: 2. Click the ![__.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360039757274) **Browse** button to add a displacement map and modify below settings as needed. ** Displacement Map ** | As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. **📝****Note:** Increase the image resolution and apply the Gaussian Blur effect to express the texture smoothly. ![Displacement_Map_tip.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360042515013) ---|--- ** Amount ** | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. e.g.) When the Amount is set to 10mm, the height for each color differs as below: White 10mm, Grey 5mm, Black 0mm ![Displacement_Map_Amount.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360041673514) ** Clipping ** | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. e.g.) When you want to delete geometries of the certain area: ![Displacement_Map_Clipping.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360041673574) **Particle Distance** | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. **📝****Note** As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. ![Displacement_Map_Particle_Distance.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360042512993) **Keep Continuity** | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. **📝****Note:** Only applicable to Welded OBJs. ![unnamed.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360042513033)
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide to applying and adjusting displacement maps for accurately expressing the thickness and texture of fabrics in the Clo3D software.

title: Run V-Ray Render
content: ### **Objective** V-Ray Render produces more vivid and sophisticated images with clear seamlines and puckerings. **Location ** Main Menu ▶ Render ▶ **Render ** Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Window ▶ **Render** ** Operation** 1. Select the too/menu indicated in Location. → The Render window appears. 2. Click on the ![interactive_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025949628) **Interactive Render** tool from the Render toolbar or click on the following direction,"Click here to start the Interactive Render," at the center of the Render window to start the real time render. → The 3D Garment and Avatar in the 3D window are rendered in real time, reflecting the [3D view](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000628267-%EB%B7%B0-%EC%A0%9C%EC%96%B4). → Any changes made to material properties are applied to the Render window in real-time when the Interactive Render is active. **📝****Note: • **When the **![Camera Lock On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/33940373641753)Lock Camera** in the Render toolbar is activated, tthe render view remains fixed while controlling the view in the 3D window. (ver 2024.1) • At the bottom left of the render window, you can adjust the size of the interactive render screen. 3. To temporarily stop the render, select the ![stop_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910647) **Stop Render** tool from the Render toolbar. → The render stops temporarily. 4. To restart the render, please select the ![interactive_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025949628) **Interactive Render** tool again. Or, to finish the render and extract the rendered image, click on the ![final_render.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115025910747) **Final Render (Image/ Video)** tool. → The final render image is saved according to the [render properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899148)**,[ light properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014899168), **and **[image/ video properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014785207)**.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on using the V-Ray Render tool to create vivid and sophisticated images with real-time rendering capabilities in Clo3D.

title: Slash & Spread
content: **List of Contents** Slash & Spread Fullness (Line) **Objective** Slash and spread a Pattern at a particular point or spread a particular area evenly based on selected segments. **Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Fullness (Point)** or **Fullness (Line)** 2D Toolbar ▶ Hold down ![Fullness_Point.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057904033/Fullness_Point.png) **Fullness (Point)** **▶![Fullness_Point.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057904033/Fullness_Point.png) Fullness (Point) **or**![Fullness_Line.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057046394/Fullness_Line.png) Fullness (Line)** **Operation** **Fullness(Point)** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated 2. Click a start point and endpoint on Pattern Outlines to draw a slash line or select an Internal Line/ Baseline. → The Pattern is divided based on the slash line. The direction of the arrow will be the one that spreads out. 3. Click the side or baseline to rotate and move the mouse cursor in the direction you want to rotate. → The pattern spreads out the corresponding distance and angle. 4. Right-Click during rotation to directly enter the distance and angle. → It rotates according to the entered value. → If the pattern has internal lines, the internal lines area also moved and rotated along with the pattern. **※ Note:** A natural Curve is applied by default when the pattern is cut. You can keep the original curvature by pressing the D key on your keyboard. (ver 6.2) **Fullness (Line)** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click a start point and endpoint on Pattern Outlines to create a fullness line. → A fullness line is selected. 3. Click a start point and endpoint on Pattern Outlines to create a slash line. → The Fullness (Line) window appears. 4. Configure Direction and Length and click **OK**. → Fullness is evenly added to the Pattern according to the input values. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for using the Slash & Spread Fullness tool to manipulate patterns in 2D design by evenly distributing fullness at specific points or along lines.

title: Alvanon Avatar (AVAC) Open
content: ### **Objective** Load purchased certified Alvanon Avatar into CLO. **📝****Note:** To successfully load an Alvanon Avatar, it must go through a certification process. Loading an avatar without certification will restrict simulation and file saving. **Location**** **Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶**Avatar** (Ctrl+Shift+A) **Operation** 1. Click the tool/menu in Location → The Open File window will appear. 2. Select the Alvanon Avatar file to be loaded and select **OK**. → Alvanon authentication window will appear. 3. Complete the certification process by entering of **Alvanon Body platform** ID/FW → If certified successfully, the avatar will be loaded.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for successfully loading a certified Alvanon Avatar into CLO, ensuring compliance with certification requirements for optimal simulation functionality.

title: Compatible with Wacom 3D Pen (ver 6.0)
content: Wacom 3D Pen Settings How to Control View in CLO Recommended Pen and Touch Settings for windows **Objective** Control the view of the screen with the Wacom Pro Pen (2D) and 3D Pen without any key combination. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKo3Ej02h_s **Location** Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ View Control ▶ **Wacom Pen** ** Operation** **Wacom 3D Pen Settings** 1. Click the **Start** button. 2. Type **Wacom Tablet Properties** and click on the first search result. 3. My devices ▶ Click the tablet connected ▶ Click the Pen settings. 4. In the **Wacom Tablet Properties** Window click on the **Pen** in the tool list. ![image-20201124-124053.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360099288374/image-20201124-124053.png) 5. Click on the plus "+" button to add an application profile. ![image-20201124-124201.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000416982/image-20201124-124201.png) 6. Click on the **Browse** button in the new window to locate CLO executable and click **OK** button. ![image-20201124-124249.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000417002/image-20201124-124249.png) 7. Set the pen button settings according to the recommended configuration for each of them. Wacom Pro Pen 2 | Wacom Pro Pen 3D ---|--- ![2d_pen.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000416682/2d_pen.png) | ![3d_pen.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000424761/3d_pen.png) How to Set Space Bar: Click the dropdown menu ▶ Keyboard ▶ Modifier ▶ Keys ▶ Check on 'Space Bar' **** **How to Control View in CLO** 1. Control the view in the following way. **Move** | Hold down the middle button while hovering, move the pen on the tablet. ---|--- **Zoom** | Hold down the middle button while the pen tip is touching the device and move the pen in the vertical direction. **Rotate** | Hold down the bottom button while the pen tip is touching or placing close to the device, move the pen to rotate. **Simulate** (Pro Pen 3D Only) | Press the top button once to turn on the simulation and press once again to turn it off. **Select Mesh (Brush)** (Ver 6.1) | When using the Select Mesh (brush) tool, resize the area where the mesh is selected based on the pressure of the pen on the tablet screen. **※Note:** Use another key (e.g. Alt) on the keyboard with the pen to control the view in the 5.2 or lower versions. **** **Recommended pen and Touch Settings for Windows.** 1. Click the **Start** button. 2. Type **Control Panel** and click on the first search result. 3. Switch the Control Panel **display mode** to a **small icon**. 4. Click on **Pen and Touch** settings. **Double-tab** | Double-click (Default Value) ---|--- **Press and hold** | Select the row ▶ Click ‘**Settings** ’ ▶Check off ‘**Enable press and hold for right-clicking**. **Pen Buttons** | Check on both menus below. * Use the pen button as a right-click equivalent. * Use the top of the pen to erase ink (where available).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide to configuring Wacom 3D Pen settings for optimal view control in CLO, enabling users to navigate their designs seamlessly without relying on keyboard shortcuts.

content: **List of Contents** Edit Unit Edit Starting Point Objective Change the unit or the starting point of the rulers. ** **Location Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Environment ▶ **Show Ruler** 2D Window ▶ ![2d_information.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016982953/2d_information.png) 2D Information ▶ ![ruler.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016237414/ruler.png) **Show Ruler** ## Operation **Edit Unit** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: (skip this step if rulers already show in the 2D window) Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Environment ▶ **Show Ruler** 2D Window ▶ ![2d_information.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016982953/2d_information.png) 2D Information ▶ ![ruler.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016237414/ruler.png) **Show Ruler** → Rulers appear in the 2D window. 2. Right click on a ruler. → A right-click pop-up window appears. 3. Select the desired unit. → The unit changes accordingly. ※Note: The default unit of the rulers is the program's unit. **Edit Starting Point** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: (skip this step if rulers already show in the 2D window) Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Environment ▶ **Show Ruler** 2D Window ▶ ![2d_information.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016982953/2d_information.png) 2D Information ▶ ![ruler.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360016237414/ruler.png) **Show Ruler** → Rulers appear in the 2D window. 2. title: 3D
content: **Objective** Change the default settings of the software in **User Settings**. Designated settings will become the default after the program is restarted. Shortcut keys, menus, graphics options, view controls, default files, font settings, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. In the 3D section, configure settings related to 3D features. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶**3D** ** Operation** 1. Adjust the settings below as needed: Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ **3D ** **Mesh** | Set the default mesh setting to **Triangle** or **Quad**. ---|--- **Arrangement** **** | Default Arrangement Shape Type | Arrange the pattern as curved or flat around the bounding volume of the Avatar when placing patterns around the avatar with arrangement points. Default Arrangement Point Size | Modify the default arrangement point size (radius). For smaller avatars, the default arrangement point size may hinder pattern arrangement, so decrease the size of the arrangement points for efficient pattern arrangement. Sync Fold Arrangement Angle | When using the [Fold Arrangement tool](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000483547-%EC%A0%91%EC%96%B4-%EB%B0%B0%EC%B9%98), change the selected Internal Line or Pattern Outline's Fold Angle accordingly (ver4.2.0). **Gizmo** | **Unified Gizmo** : Select, move, and rotate with a single Gizmo tool. **Divided Gizmo** : Select (Q), Move (W), Rotate (E) are divided into separate Gizmo tools. The Divided Gizmo tool automatically reassigns the **Pin** shortcut key from W to P on the keyboard. If P is already in use as a shortcut key, a shortcut key will not be applied to **Pin** (ver2.5.0).
content_description: This web page provides guidance on customizing software default settings in the User Settings menu, focusing on 3D features and configuration options to enhance user experience.

title: Fix Grid Display
content: ### **Objective** This option is to fix the grid spacing regardless of the zoom of the 2D window, which makes it easier to recognize the magnification or reduction of the 2D window. ** Location ** Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ **Grid Properties**(ver3.2 or earlier) Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 3D/2D Window ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ **Grid Properties**(ver3.2 or earlier) Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 3D/2D Window ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) → The properties related to the 2D window appear in the Property Editor. 2. 2D Grid ▶ Show 2D Grid ▶ Turn On → **Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom** appears in Property Editor. 3. **Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom** ▶ On/Off → When the Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is activated, the grid zooms in and out automatically as the 2D window zooms in and out. On the other hand, when the Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is deactivated, the grid is fixed and maintains its assigned size. **※ Note:** The Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is activated by default.
content_description: This web page provides instructions for adjusting grid properties in a 2D window to enhance visibility and recognition of magnification changes, ensuring a consistent user experience across different zoom levels.
